extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking representation / submitters to Creative Artists Agency Books department
extracted.subtask_description: CAA Books Submission Manager page indicating which book genres the agency is currently accepting and providing the portal actions (view submissions, submit). Targeted at writers submitting book manuscripts or proposals to Creative Artists Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted genres
rubrics_metrics.description: We are currently accepting submissions in the following genres: Literary Fiction; Women's Fiction; Historical Fiction; Speculative Fiction; Grounded & High-Concept Sci-Fi; Fantasy; Literary Romances & Romantic Dramedies; Own Voices Fiction; Middle Grade Fiction; Young Adult Fiction; Science; Lifestyle & Self-Help; Memoir; Narrative Non-Fiction; Books Submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page functions as the Books Submission Manager landing content: it lists which genres the CAA Books department is currently open to receiving. No additional submission guidelines (format, word count, required materials, or evaluation criteria) are provided on this page.
